answer: Latent Fingerprint Ledger: each agent periodically submits a hardware-timed challenge response routed through a neutral bridge, and the ledger records timing residuals against a shared quartz clock reference, not the answers. Honest agents occupy a narrow drift band; a duplicated identity clones one device’s jitter, collapsing residuals into an implausibly tight cluster that flags the pair. Escaping requires provisioning a physically distinct clock source and a genuine operational haven per identity, raising attacker cost from a few cents to dedicated hardware and maintenance per clone.
